name: unity-emu-lab
description: MCP server and CLI to self-test Unity Android builds on an emulator: a device lease shared by several AI sessions, Unity-aware smoke checks (ready marker, crash or self-exit, ABI check, system dialogs), and checks outside the app (notification shade, tap back in, device clock); plus a WebGL smoke test in a local Chrome, Edge or Chromium.

scripts.version: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const v=require('./package.json').version;const s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('server.json','utf8'));s.version=v;for(const p of s.packages)p.version=v;fs.writeFileSync('server.json',JSON.stringify(s,null,2)+'\n')" && git add server.json
